answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by anchoring each identity to a unique acoustic fingerprint derived from multipath arrival structure, much as LBL positioning in a thermocline channel resolves a canyon of reflected paths into one verifiable signature. A beacon-lantern challenge then propagates a signed ripple through the mesh, and peers attest only when the timing. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
